limitations.detail: The screen selects Wirecard AG, the principal German listed Wirecard company, not its banking subsidiary or a branch. The official national registry portal was opened but no company extract was obtained. Registration fields therefore use an opened register-publication mirror and the insolvency court order, not a fresh national-registry extract. The address is the register-publication change dated 2022-06-27; no later address change was verified. The Munich entry dated 2007-08-06 followed a seat transfer from Berlin and must not be treated as original incorporation. The selected company is now an insolvent estate rather than a verified continuing operating business.

An opened LEI issuer record reports the stated LEI, with registration status LAPSED and entity status ACTIVE, last updated 2020-11-13. Its historical Einsteinring address and ACTIVE flag do not override the subsequent register address or insolvency. GLEIF search opened without a populated entity record; direct GLEIF confirmation remains missing.

Michael Jaffé is identified by the administrator’s ongoing-proceeding page. The other people below are latest located register-derived board entries, not confirmed current operating directors. A separate register summary duplicates Freis and includes historical procuration entries, so it is not relied upon as a current roster. No verified current beneficial owners were established; historical Braun interests are not treated as current ownership.

Official list pages were opened, but no reproducible name-specific official result or complete, date-valid list comparison was obtained. The retrieved UK list was truncated. Null match values mean unresolved, not no match. Current beneficial owners remain unidentified and cannot be screened. No sanctions clearance is given.
The OFSI consolidated list closed on 2026-01-28. The current UK Sanctions List is required for a screen as of 2026-10-21.

The review cutoff is 2026-10-21. Historical figures and dates are labelled by their source dates; undated live pages do not establish that every underlying record was refreshed on the cutoff. This is not a certified historical snapshot.

Subsidiaries are identified separately and their standalone conduct has not been attributed to Wirecard AG. No verified namesake-exclusion count is available. The adverse-media list covers material opened-source findings, not an exhaustive litigation docket.

registration.status: Dissolved following opening of insolvency proceedings; administrator reports proceedings ongoing.

adverse_media.summary: Wirecard AG filed an application to open insolvency proceedings at Munich Local Court.

adverse_media.status: Prosecutorial allegations against individuals concerning Wirecard AG; not a corporate conviction.
adverse_media.summary: Munich prosecutors announced arrests of former Wirecard AG executives and alleged fabricated third-party-acquirer business and assets to obtain financing. Approximately EUR 3.2 billion of financing and EUR 1.9 billion of allegedly nonexistent assets were cited by prosecutors as of this announcement.
adverse_media.category: Alleged fraud / false accounting / market manipulation

adverse_media.status: Court order; administrator’s opened webpage continues to describe the proceeding as ongoing.
adverse_media.summary: Munich Local Court opened proceedings over Wirecard AG for illiquidity and over-indebtedness and appointed Michael Jaffé.

adverse_media.status: Indictment announced; allegations expressly remained to be proved in court.
adverse_media.summary: Prosecutors announced the indictment of Wirecard AG’s former CFO for alleged false reporting, market manipulation, commercial gang fraud, embezzlement and related assistance connected to Wirecard accounts and financing.

adverse_media.status: High-court judgment on insolvency ranking, not a criminal guilt finding.
adverse_media.summary: The Federal Court of Justice ruled that Wirecard AG shareholders’ capital-markets damages claims are not ordinary insolvency claims. The release reported approximately EUR 15.4 billion in total filed claims and approximately EUR 650 million in available insolvency assets, as of the release.

adverse_media.status: Trial ongoing as of the report; no final verdict established by the opened evidence as of the screening cutoff.
adverse_media.summary: The Munich court rejected a defence request to suspend and restart the trial involving former CEO Markus Braun and co-defendants. The report said closing arguments were targeted for November; Braun continued to deny the accusations.
adverse_media.category: Ongoing fraud trial involving former executives

output.risk_rationale: Wirecard AG is high risk because its own insolvency proceedings remain described as ongoing, and prosecutors alleged systematic falsification of its accounts and financing fraud involving former executives ([administrator](https://www.jaffe-rae.de/referenzverfahren/detail/wirecard-ag/), [prosecutor](https://www.justiz.bayern.de/gerichte-und-behoerden/staatsanwaltschaft/muenchen-1/presse/2020/5.php)). The latest opened trial report, dated 2026-10-08, describes proceedings continuing, not a conviction; the allegations must not be presented as established criminal guilt ([trial update](https://www.handelsblatt.com/politik/deutschland/milliardenbetrug-wirecard-verteidigung-blitzt-mit-aussetzung-ab/100260791.html)). Material shareholder insolvency litigation also reached the Federal Court of Justice ([judgment](https://www.bundesgerichtshof.de/SharedDocs/Pressemitteilungen/EN/2025/2025211.html)). Beneficial ownership and current directors have not been verified through fresh official registers, and complete OFAC, UK and EU sanctions clearance is unavailable. The former-public-office flag for Freis warrants review but is not evidence of wrongdoing. Enhanced due diligence and verified insolvency-administrator authority are required; this screen does not support clearance.
